setup.title: Launch the CloudLab experiment (1 name server + 2 load generators)
commands: python3 cloudlab_api/launch.py launch --name dns-r320 --num-testers 2 --server-software bind --server-hw r320 --tester-hw r320
python3 cloudlab_api/launch.py status <experiment_id>   # node ssh commands

setup.title: On test_host_0: create an SSH key and authorize it on every node
commands: cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub   # append this line to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on NS_Local and test_host_1

setup.title: On test_host_0: generate the zone and load it on the name server
On every load generator: receive replies on one RX queue (kxdpgun in generic mode reads queue 0 only)
Point the search config at this machine
Use the second load generator too (test_host_1, 10.10.1.3)

optimize.title: Host changes (run as root on NS_Local)
commands:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/dnsperf-turbo.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
modprobe msr
python3 -c "import struct,os
for c in range(os.cpu_count()):
    fd=os.open('/dev/cpu/%d/msr'%c,os.O_RDWR); v=struct.unpack('<Q',os.pread(fd,8,0x1a0))[0]; os.pwrite(fd,struct.pack('<Q',v&~(1<<38)),0x1a0); os.close(fd)"
echo 0 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/intel_pstate/no_turbo
for g in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor; do echo powersave > $g; echo performance > $g; done
python3 -c "import struct,os
for c in range(os.cpu_count()):
    fd=os.open('/dev/cpu/%d/msr'%c,os.O_RDWR); os.pwrite(fd,struct.pack('<Q',0x1d00),0x199); os.close(fd)"
echo always > /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled
nohup /bin/bash /etc/systemd/system/dnsperf-sampler.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &
exit 0
EOF

cat > /etc/systemd/system/dnsperf-sampler.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
P=/usr/lib/linux-tools/5.15.0-187-generic/perf
O=/var/local/dnsperf-run18
mkdir -p $O; rm -f $O/*
nstat -n >/dev/null
for i in $(seq 1 400); do
  sleep 4
  r=$(nstat UdpInDatagrams 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="UdpInDatagrams"{print int($2/4)}')
  echo "$(date +%T) ${r:-0}" >> $O/rates
  if [ "${r:-0}" -gt 560000 ]; then
    $P stat -a -e cycles,ref-cycles,instructions -- sleep 5 > $O/freq.txt 2>&1
    $P record -F 199 -a -g -o $O/perf.data -- sleep 6 >/dev/null 2>&1
    exit 0
  fi
done
EOF

cat > /etc/systemd/system/dnsperf-zoneguard.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
for i in $(seq 1 600); do
  s=$(stat -c %s /etc/bind/db.workbench.lan 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  if [ "$s" -lt 1000000 ]; then cp -p /var/local/dnsperf-orig/db.workbench.lan /etc/bind/db.workbench.lan; logger dnsperf-zoneguard restored zone; rndc reload workbench.lan; fi
  if [ $i -le 90 ]; then
    ethtool -K enp8s0d1 gro off >/dev/null 2>&1
    sysctl -qw net.ipv4.conf.enp8s0d1.rp_filter=0 net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=0 net.core.default_qdisc=pfifo_fast
    if ethtool -c enp8s0d1 | grep -q 'Adaptive RX: on'; then ethtool -C enp8s0d1 adaptive-rx off rx-usecs 256 rx-frames 512 tx-usecs 256 tx-frames 256 >/dev/null 2>&1; logger dnsperf coalesce set; fi
    if tc qdisc show dev enp8s0d1 | grep -q fq_codel; then tc qdisc replace dev enp8s0d1 root handle 1: mq; logger dnsperf qdisc set; fi
  fi
  sleep 2
done
EOF

changes: root: sed -i 's/^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT=.*/GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT="mitigations=off cpufreq.default_governor=performance intel_idle.max_cstate=1 processor.max_cstate=1 transparent_hugepage=always"/' /etc/default/grub
